entities.name: Seshiro
entities.description: Snake monk called the Anointed, orochi Broodmaster during the Kami War, son of Suzue.

entities.name: Suzue
entities.description: Orochi mother of Seshiro, fatally wounded by a kami of decay.

entities.name: Dosan
entities.description: Monk of Okina saved by Seshiro.

entities.name: Sosuke
entities.description: Child of Seshiro, leader of the Kashi tribe.

entities.name: Sachi
entities.description: Child of Seshiro, leader of the Sakura tribe.

entities.name: Kaseto
entities.description: Archmage who carried on Seshiro's wisdom.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War on Kamigawa during which Seshiro was Broodmaster.

entities.name: Okina
entities.description: Temple where human monks taught Seshiro.

events.summary: Suzue brings Seshiro to the Okina temple to be taught martial arts by human monks.
events.quote: Seshiro was brought by his mother to the Okina temple

events.summary: Suzue, Seshiro and Dosan are attacked by a kami of decay; Seshiro saves Dosan but Suzue is fatally wounded.
events.quote: Seshiro saved Dosan, but Suzue was fatally wounded.

events.summary: Seshiro becomes Broodmaster of the orochi colonies.
events.quote: became Broodmaster, as foretold by the shamans

relations.quote: Broodmaster of the Orochi colonies of Kamigawa during the Kami War
Seshiro's wisdom would be carried on by the Archmage Kaseto
